scene_target: Rhea attempts to gather more resources but discovers micro-taxes threaten her remaining 1 HP, forcing her to halt.
goal: Gather loose branches and more fungus to offset stamina loss.
conflict: Every interaction triggers a System micro-tax, threatening to drain her last hit point.
required_callbacks: The 85 Stamina Gathering Tax from the previous scene.
constraints: Rhea's HP is already at 1, so the stamina drain must trigger a critical System warning threatening to deduct from HP (which would be fatal) rather than actually reducing it below 1.
end_condition: Rhea stops gathering entirely, realizing the standard rules are a death trap.
transition_in_text: Rhea, winded and holding her single Ash-Fungus, tries to gather basic firewood to survive the environment.
transition_out_text: Rhea sits motionless, refusing to interact with the environment to avoid fatal System taxes.

last_scene: Rhea attempted to gather loose branches for firewood.
The System applied micro-taxes to her stamina for every branch she touched.
Her stamina reached zero, triggering a critical warning that further actions would deduct from her 1 HP.
Realizing the gathering taxes were fatal, Rhea sat motionless to avoid interacting with the environment.
key_events: Rhea tried to gather firewood in the Ash-Choked Forest.
The System charged her Stamina for picking up minor debris.
Rhea's Stamina hit 0, applying the Exhaustion status.
A System warning alerted her that stamina deficits would draw from HP, threatening instant death.
Rhea stopped gathering entirely and sat motionless to survive.
